result.message: Testing stage. You will be given 3 test inputs, one at a time and answered separately. Apply the same transformation rule to each and submit the predicted output grid with submit_final_answer.

output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=0]
    if not pts: return out
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    # the colored seed is a 3x3 block
    cr=(r0+r1)//2; cc=(c0+c1)//2
    for r,c in pts:
        dr=0 if r==cr else (1 if r>cr else -1)
        dc=0 if c==cc else (1 if c>cc else -1)
        if dr==0 and dc==0: continue
        rr=r+dr; col=c+dc
        while 0<=rr<h and 0<=col<w:
            out[rr][col]=grid[r][c]
            rr+=dr; col+=dc
    return out"}

{"code":"def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # identify the 3x3 nonzero block bounding box
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=0]
    if not cells: return out
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
    # expected 3x3 block; each perimeter position sends outward
    rm=(r0+r1)//2; cm=(c0+c1)//2
    for r,c in cells:
        if r==rm and c==cm: continue
        dr=(r-rm); dc=(c-cm)
        sr=0 if dr==0 else (1 if dr>0 else -1)
        sc=0 if dc==0 else (1 if dc>0 else -1)
        rr=r+sr; cc=c+sc
        while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w:
            out[rr][cc]=grid[r][c]
            rr+=sr; cc+=sc
    return out"}

{"code":"def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v]
    if not pts: return out
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    # object is the 3x3 nine-cell pattern; center of its bounding box
    rm=(r0+r1)//2; cm=(c0+c1)//2
    for r,c in pts:
        if r==rm and c==cm: continue
        dr=0 if r==rm else (1 if r>rm else -1)
        dc=0 if c==cm else (1 if c>cm else -1)
        rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
        while 0<=rr<len(grid) and 0<=cc<len(grid[0]):
            out[rr][cc]=grid[r][c]
            rr+=dr; cc+=dc
    return out"}
